patterns.name: Acceleration Index
patterns.description: Current movement is at least 2x the validated baseline.

patterns.name: Deviation Sigma
patterns.description: Signal is at least three standard deviations from baseline.

patterns.name: Source Confidence
patterns.description: Source confidence meets the verified-data threshold.

patterns.name: Fresh Observation
patterns.description: Observation was recorded within the last fifteen minutes.
